fusion_rules.average: Arithmetic mean of the two probability vectors with equal weights.
fusion_rules.gate: Choose the lower-entropy probability vector with encoder first on exact ties.
fusion_rules.geometric: Softmax of the equal mean of log probabilities clamped below at 1e-8.
fusion_rules.rank: Sum equal Borda rank points from both experts. Average rank points for tied probabilities. Add 1e-6 times arithmetic mean probability, clamp below at 1e-12, and normalize.
